title: #cstouterspace #chicagoshakespeare #chicago #theatre
transcript: last night my friend Katy and I saw the press opening of “it came from outer space” the new musical by Joe Kinosian & Kellen Blair playing at the Chicago shakespeare theater it's based on the classic Ray Bradbury 3-D film now the draw for me is this amazing ensemble they play 1 million roles they are so so talented by the way Chicago shakes put pronouns in bios at the bare minimum please especially for a show that's about acceptance and kindness towards others anyway I wasn't sure what to expect going into the show I guess I was expecting it to be more campy and there was some camp but mostly it was a lot of heart and a lot of laughs some of the jokes and scenes went over my head because I have not seen the movie it's based on so it felt like a little bit we were spending too much time on scenes that didn't really seem to move the plot that much for but I guess they were based on the movie the score by kinosian and Blair is very vintage really fun. costumes lighting and scenery are pitch perfect it was a good in the theater 90min go see it
